apps.name: Git + GitHub CLI
apps.description: Installs git and the GitHub CLI (gh) into the workspace, survives restarts, and provides a settings panel for gh login (token stored in the zero-knowledge secret store).

apps.name: AWS CLI
apps.description: Installs the AWS CLI v2 into the workspace and provides a settings panel for AWS credentials (access key, secret key, region, session token — applied via `aws configure`, secret fields routed to the zero-knowledge secret store).

apps.name: Google Cloud CLI
apps.description: Installs the Google Cloud CLI (`gcloud`) into the workspace and provides a settings panel for project/account defaults and optional service-account JSON setup.

apps.name: Essential CLI Tools
apps.description: Installs a broad set of workspace CLI tooling and keeps it present across restarts: core networking/utilities (telnet, ping, curl, nc, perl, python, vim, docker), Go, a Node.js dev toolkit (nvm, node, npm, npx, yarn, pnpm), Terraform, and Homebrew (Linuxbrew). Consolidates what used to be four separate apps (essentials, node, terraform, brew) into one, since they're all the same kind of thing: pure command installs, no login/settings/secrets.

apps.name: AW Proxy
apps.description: Browser cookie proxy: the HTTP CONNECT proxy the AW Browser tunnels through, the /sync-cookies + /clear-cookies API the aw-sync browser extensions (Chrome + iOS/Safari, downloadable from the app's window) push cookies through, and encrypted persistence of chosen cookies in Postgres so they survive a proxy restart. aw-app-browser depends on this app for authentication.

apps.name: Browser
apps.description: Chromium for AW workspaces with an interactive noVNC screen, CDP automation endpoint, workspace cookie-proxy support, and configurable window size.

apps.name: Presentations
apps.description: HTML presentations created by agents (diffs, reports, dashboards) — top-bar gallery nav + a window that renders each presentation. Replaces the monolith's /ws/presentations feature and the aw-frontend static PresentationNav.

apps.name: Whiteboard
apps.description: Persistent, live-synced HTML canvas — set/patch content, broadcast changes over a WebSocket to every open viewer, round-trip with a presentation. Migrated from the aw monolith (src/api/routes/whiteboard.py + whiteboard_manager.py + WhiteboardWindow.jsx).

apps.name: MCP Gateway
apps.description: Share your workspace's tools with any AI agent, and reach tools from other workspaces in return. Install MCP Gateway and every tool your other apps expose becomes instantly callable — no per-app setup. Connect it to another gateway to pull in that workspace's tools too, with per-connection access tokens you control.

apps.name: Hello World (App Template)
apps.description: TEMPLATE — a minimal, fully working decoupled app: installs one trivial CLI (`hello`, prints a configurable greeting) through the gated commands:install facade, contributes a backend sub-app (GET /hello + app-local WS /ws/echo under the app namespace) and a component-mode frontend bundle, and runs standalone too (ADR Decision 4/6). Tests and CI/marketplace release already wired. Rename everything marked TEMPLATE/hello before this becomes a real app — see README.md.

apps.name: DevCtl
apps.description: Dev-control panel for the workspace — observe/control the workspace browser by talking CDP to the aw-app-browser container (live screenshot + navigation). Scaffold: first capability wired to aw-app-browser:9223.

apps.name: MCP Tools
apps.description: Installs MCP helper tools for Agentic Workspace, starting with a ready-to-use Playwright MCP config for shared browser automation.

apps.name: Code Agent CLIs
apps.description: Installs AI coding-agent CLIs into the workspace: Claude Code (claude), OpenAI Codex (codex), GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot), and Cursor's cursor-agent. Pure command installs, no login/settings/secrets bundled here — each CLI still needs its own auth (e.g. `claude login`, `codex login`, `copilot`, `cursor-agent login`) run from a workspace terminal before use.

apps.name: Agents Platform Runners
apps.description: Depends on the code-agent-clis app (claude/codex/copilot/cursor-agent already installed at /usr/local/bin, single source of truth) so this workspace's agent-CLI runners are what agents-platform_multitenant's agent sessions use, and contributes the ported "aw-agents" MCP (agent_mcp.py) so agents-platform is controllable as MCP tools from this workspace.
